answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The whisper cap is enforced at intake and spiral publishes the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a ember tag. That is 6 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
